newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel reinforces troops in West Bank, Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Israel reinforces troops in West Bank, Gaza.

text.p: Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai said on Monday he had reinforced troops in the West Bank and Gaza Strip to prevent Palestinian unrest when construction on a new Jewish settlement begins this week.
"I ordered the deployment of forces starting today along a very wide perimeter in the Gaza Strip, the West Bank and along the seam," Mordechai told Israel Radio.
Israel's decision to build 6,500 new housing units for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem has angered Palestinians who say the move violates Israel-PLO peace deals.

Israeli security officials have warned that the start of construction slated for this week could spark violence in the West Bank and Gaza Strip similiar to clashes last September in which 61 Palestinians and 15 Israeli soldiers were killed.
"Our working assumption is that incidents are likely to occur, even severe incidents. For this reason we have deployed our forces," said Mordechai.
Israel claims all of Jerusalem as its capital. Palestinians view East Jerusalem, which Israel captured in the 1967 Middle East war, as the capital of their future state.
